# Open the Shapewall board

1. `board_link` for what the person asked to see: the board, a page (`page`), a comment (`comment`), a screen size (`viewport`) or a page before and after (`compare`). With no tools, `shapewall open --print` in the project prints the same link.
2. If your app has a browser pane, open the link there; otherwise open it in the person's browser or give them the link.

Opening the board changes nothing on it.

No `shapewall` tools? The plugin starts `shapewall mcp` in the project folder; the project needs a `shapewall.config.json` (`npx shapewall init`). See https://shapewall.com/docs/plugins.
